serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, delivered as a cloud service and accessed through multiple interfaces that share the same underlying platform, models, and security controls: the Claude application on web, desktop, and mobile; Claude Code for agentic software development; Claude Cowork for delegating multi-step knowledge work; and the Claude API and Developer Platform for programmatic access to Claude models and agent-building capabilities. Users interact with Claude in natural language to draft and analyze documents, reason over uploaded files, search connected data sources, write and run code, and automate multi-step work. Organization administrators manage identity, access, data retention, and audit controls across all interfaces from a single deployment. Customer content is not used to train Anthropic's models by default.
